description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Vacation Home: * Private Pool (Heated for Add’l Fee $50/night)* Pet Friendly (add'l fee $250)* 4 Bikes Included!* 3 Master KING Bedrooms* Short Stroll to the Sugar-White Sands* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Brozinni Pizzeria, Cafe 30A, Angelina's Italian, or Dough Sea Dough* Under 2 miles to Seaside! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs every month from January through February. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please get in touch with us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Villa Palmeira — Your Dream Coastal Escape in Santa Rosa Beach, 30A, Florida. Nestled in the heart of the scenic 30A corridor, Villa Palmeira is located within the exclusive, gated community of Palmeira Villas, providing easy access to Seaside, Seagrove Beach, and other popular destinations along 30A. This stunning retreat is perfect for families, couples, or groups seeking an unforgettable beach getaway. Step into the chef’s kitchen, complete with a spacious island and seating ideal for everything from quick breakfasts to gourmet dinners. Enjoy your mornings with coffee on the back patio, soaking in the tranquil coastal surroundings. The home’s thoughtful layout includes King master suite on 2nd floor with ensuite bathroom and a guest bedroom with 4 twin beds (2 sets of bunk beds). The third Floor has 2 King master suites with ensuite bathrooms. Coming soon is an additional Queen bedroom with ensuite bathroom as well. This setup makes Villa Palmeira perfect for families or multiple groups traveling together. Hop on the bikes provided and spend your sunny days at the nearby beach. You can also unwind at your private pool, set on a covered terrace with a convenient half bath perfect for relaxing, dining al fresco, or unwinding after a day in the sun.** Please note: Pet Fee is $250/pet and is nonrefundable.Palmeira Villas at Seagrove Beach is an exclusive, gated community with gorgeous luxury homes, located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on Hwy 30A. Only 1.8 miles from Seaside, this small community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle! Hungry? There are many fabulous local restaurants nearby, such as Café 30A, Angelina’s Pizzeria, Dough Sea Dough, and The Perfect Pig Gourmet Market. Come experience Palmeira Villas and see what makes the 30A area world famous!The Bed Setup: 2nd FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Beds 3rd Floor:Master Bedroom 2: King BedMaster Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedArea Attractions: Villa by the Sea is centrally located on 30A with only a short bike ride to the excellent shopping and dining options of Seaside! If you prefer a leisurely stroll, then Café 30A is only minutes away and constantly ranked as one of the best restaurants on 30A. Angelina's is also within walking distance for pasta or pizza. Walk to The Dough Sea Dough for morning donuts or breakfast sandwiches. The Big Chill at Prominence, around 3 miles east, is a great place to take kids, watch an outdoor movie, listen to music, or eat at one of the half a dozen unique eateries.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
